entries.back_en: "Indeed, young dragon. Thou hast already met us before. I am Pung Ryong. The Wind Dragon."
entries.note: Adiciona 'antes' mas mantem sentido; tom arcaico ok.

entries.back_en: "The Yorae Dragon... He whose role is not yet established."
"I'd like you (pl.) to share your power with him... If he can gain the powers of the ancient dragons, perhaps"
"Although we do not wish to see thee fail in thine endeavor, Deis, know this... Thou who possessest no form of thine own..."
entries.note: 'saiba' deveria ser 'saibas' p/ consistencia, mas minimo.

entries.back_en: "As thou well knowest, the other half of the Yorae Dragon is the First Emperor of the Fou Empire,"
"He has already awakened."
"What do you mean he can't escape it!? We don't want him to join with his other half! That's why we called you-- to help us prevent that from happening!"
"...Listen, dear. You remember what the Abbess in Chek told you about the 'pillars of light' and all, right?"
"Hear us, Deis. We who watch over this world must ever strive to maintain a position of neutrality. It matters not which becomes a god, does it not?"
entries.note: 'nao importa qual... nao importa?' repete; tag question soaria melhor 'nao e?'.

entries.back_en: "Wouldst thou use a god's power for thine own benefit?"
"And how are the mortals of this world any different!? They yank us from our worlds and make us into gods! They make us work for their benefit!"
"Are you (pl.) telling me to stay like this, in this borrowed body, forever!?"
"Thou speakest as though thou knowest not our way... Once we have served our purpose, once our time as gods has passed, we become as thou seest us now--dragons."
"The Yorae Dragon..."
"Before that destiny is fulfilled, seek our true selves so that thou mightest gain our power."
"When"
"Just tell me one thing... When you were all brought here, didn't any of you think about trying to get back home?"
"Um, Deis? Why do you want to return to where you came from so strongly? Is it because you don't like it here? ...What about you,"
"I am [name], of the Imperial Army. You are"
"We know you are the one called the Yorae Dragon. You will come with us."
